summary: wrong row: takes_deactivate × accept → take should be kept with active:false, but the case falls into the takes_remove branch and deletes the take
fix: Give takes_deactivate its own branch: `const t = store.takes.get(p.takeId); if (t) store.takes.set(p.takeId, { ...t, active: false }); break;`
evidence: Lines 40-42: `case 'takes_deactivate': case 'takes_remove': store.takes.delete(p.takeId)`. The trust guard exists so agents cannot destroy takes without owner review; an owner accepting a deactivate loses the record permanently.

summary: wrong row: takes_replace (same claim) × accept → take should be kept unchanged, but the fall-through lands in the delete branch and removes the take
fix: End the takes_replace case with an unconditional `break` (a same-claim replace is a no-op); never fall through into the remove branch.
evidence: Line 34 guards the rewrite with `p.claim !== current.claim`; when the claim is equal (or p.claim is undefined, or the take is missing) control reaches line 42 `store.takes.delete(p.takeId)`. The comment says 'nothing new to write' but the code deletes.

summary: collapsed kinds: takes_deactivate, same-claim takes_replace and takes_remove all share the single destructive `store.takes.delete` branch; only takes_remove is tested, so the other two look covered while deleting data
fix: One branch per kind in acceptProposal: remove deletes, deactivate sets active:false, replace rewrites or no-ops. Add a `default: throw` or exhaustive `never` check so a future kind cannot silently inherit the delete path.
evidence: test/proposals.test.ts:18 covers only takes_remove through this branch.

summary: untested cell: takes_deactivate × accept → take kept with active:false, proposal accepted
fix: Add a test that proposes takes_deactivate on a seeded take, accepts it, and asserts the full take row and proposal status.

summary: untested cell: takes_deactivate × drop → take unchanged (active:true), proposal dropped
fix: Add a drop test for the takes_deactivate kind asserting the take row is untouched and status is 'dropped'.

summary: untested cell: takes_replace (same claim) × accept → take kept unchanged, proposal accepted
fix: Add a test that accepts a takes_replace whose claim equals the current claim and asserts the take still exists unchanged.

summary: untested cell: takes_replace (same claim) × drop → take unchanged, proposal dropped
fix: Add a drop test for a same-claim takes_replace asserting the take row is untouched and status is 'dropped'.

summary: untested cell: takes_replace (new claim) × drop → take keeps its old claim, proposal dropped
fix: Add a drop test for takes_replace with a differing claim asserting the original claim remains and status is 'dropped'.

summary: untested cell: takes_add × drop → no take created, proposal dropped
fix: Add a drop test for takes_add asserting the target id is absent from store.takes and status is 'dropped'.
